mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising, and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE decreases, and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and Industrial Production (INDPRO) declines, it signals a weakening supply-side and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < 1% and INDPRO declines, and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
